register_corrade_printers: register the Corrade GDB pretty-printers with a given objfile or the global progspace
build_corrade_printer: build the RegexpCollectionPrettyPrinter that maps Corrade C++ types to their Python pretty-printer classes
review_CorradeTypePrinter: review the CorradeTypePrinter base class that all pretty-printers inherit from for custom type display
review_CorradeArray: review the CorradeArray printer class that iterates over Containers::Array and ArrayView elements via ArrayIterator
review_CorradeOptional: review the CorradeOptional printer class that handles Containers::Optional with nested visualizer support
